rows.post: Assistant Professor (Remote Sensing & Geographic Information System)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for PAU Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Matric level certificate of Punjabi language is required for posts. Residence in the PAU Campus shall be mandatory for Medical Officer (General). In-service candidates must apply through proper channel with advance copy reaching by last date. Desirable: Substantial contribution in Agricultural Communication/Journalism/Public Relations for Additional Director. M.D. (Medicine) for Medical Officer. Expertise in Remote Sensing & GIS software for Assistant Professor.

rows.qualification: Master's degree with 65% marks or OCPA 6.50 and Ph.D. with 12 years experience (or Master's with 15 years)
Master's degree in Plant Pathology with NET and publication
M.Sc. Forestry with NET and publication
Master Degree in Vegetable Crops/Horticulture (Vegetable)/Olericulture with NET and publication
Master’s degree in Bioinformatics/Bioinformatics and System Biology with NET and publication
Master’s degree in Biochemistry with NET and publication
Master Degree in Horticulture (Vegetable Science)/Vegetable Science with NET and publication
Master’s degree in Agronomy with NET and publication
Master’s degree in Agril. Meteorology/Agril. Physics with specialization in Agril. Meteorology with NET and publication
Master’s degree in Agricultural Extension/Extension Education with NET and publication

rows.post: Assistant Professor (Remote Sensing & Geographic Information System)
rows.qualification: Master Degree in Remote Sensing & GIS/Geoinformatics with publication
Master’s Degree with 55% marks and 9 years experience as Assistant Professor or 5 years administrative experience as Assistant Controller of Examination
MBBS recognized by MCI with at least two years experience in any clinical branch
Graduation and diploma in Sanitary Inspector Course
10+2 with 2nd division or 10+2 and graduate with 50% marks, plus 3 years experience and 6 months computer diploma

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The post mentioned at Sr. No. 1 is tenurial post for a term of four years. The appointment against posts shall be co-terminus with the schemes in which these are provided. Probation period for Medical Officer (General) is three years.

content_sections.heading: How Will PAU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of application forms Written competitive examination (for specific posts like Sanitary Inspector) Practical test (for Packer post) Interview for eligible/shortlisted candidates Sanitary Inspector selection based on written competitive exam only. Packer selection involves a practical test assessing accuracy and speed.

content_sections.heading: PAU Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination will be of two hours duration and in English language only. Each question carries 4 marks with negative marking of 1 mark for each incorrect answer. Candidates must obtain minimum 40% marks in the competitive examination (35% for SC and BC of Punjab).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PAU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Fill online application form through PAU official website (www.pau.edu or https://r.pau-apms.in/). Deposit the prescribed non-refundable fee through electronic mode. Take print of the filled application form. Attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, publications, experience certificates, and fee receipt. Submit the hard copy of application form by post or in person to the office mentioned against each post by 16.12.2026 up to 04:00 p.m. Apply on or before 9 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Submission of hardcopy of application form along with all documents is mandatory. The complete application form must be page numbered, tagged, indexed, and signed on each page. Separate application form along with fee must be submitted for applying to more than one post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 9 December 2026. Applications opened on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Additional Director Communication: Rs. 1298. Sanitary Inspector: Rs. 590. Packer: Rs. 118.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 37 years (as on 1st January of the year in which the post is being advertised). Relaxation: contract_employees Up to 45 years for employees engaged on contract basis in PAU/Govt organizations, punjab_govt_employees Up to 45 years for employees in employment of Govt of Punjab / other State Govt / Govt of India for posts 12 to 15.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 1,44,200 (level-14) + Spl. allowance Rs. 800 for Additional Director Communication, Rs. 57,700 (level-10) for Plant Pathologist, Rs. 57,700 (level-10) for Scientist (Forestry), Rs. 57,700 (level-10) for Horticulture Scientist (Vegetables), Rs. 57,700 (level-10) for Bioinformatician.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D, Master's degree, M.Sc, MBBS, Diploma, Graduate, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Matric level certificate of Punjabi language is required for posts. Residence in the PAU Campus shall be mandatory for Medical Officer (General). In-service candidates must apply through proper channel with advance copy reaching by last date.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of application forms. Written competitive examination (for specific posts like Sanitary Inspector). Practical test (for Packer post). Interview for eligible/shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there negative marking in the PAU exam?
faq.answer: Each question carries 4 marks with negative marking of 1 mark for each incorrect answer.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post mentioned at Sr. No. 1 is tenurial post for a term of four years. The appointment against posts shall be co-terminus with the schemes in which these are provided. Probation period for Medical Officer (General) is three years.
